title: Expose inherited ownership and unresolved selection paths
preconditions: Use inherited_test fixture: 100-line store.go, containing evidence 14-96, selected range 14-40, System→store path, plus an undeclared missing-Component path.

steps.action: Resolve the valid and undeclared paths and evaluate inherited coverage.
steps.expected_result: Valid selection attaches, invalid path remains unresolved; 27 of 101 change atoms are covered and the other 74 stay uncovered.

steps.action: Inspect each inherited owner and the original Item/landmark code arrays.
steps.expected_result: Each owner names the Item, store-read selection and two-hop path; authored code arrays remain empty.
